config.design: All16 H685 residual0/1 candidates. Up to4 deterministic natural example pairs/block, same token and sampled position, different documents, both active. Both directions. Replace decoded block contribution only, versus same-norm global training PCA16 and fixed random16 projections of the full donor-receiver delta; full residual swap reference. Donor-distribution KL gain and receiver KL kept separate.
config.limitations: Exploratory validation reuse, small pairs/block, partial activation swaps may be off manifold. Full residual swap not an upper bound; donor prefix differs. PCA/random controls match edit size, not dictionary capacity or nonlinear gating.
